item.title: Why I took part in ambassadorial screening despite calling for withdrawal of list– Ndume
item.description: Ali Ndume, former senate leader, has explained why he participated in the screening of ambassadorial nominees despite earlier calling on President Bola Tinubu to withdraw the list over alleged breach of the federal character principle. item.title: Eight-month-old baby, woman killed as two buses collide in Lagos
item.description: An eight-month-old baby and a woman have died following a collision involving two commercial buses on Ikorodu Road in Lagos State. The Lagos State Traffic Management Authority (LASTMA) said the accident occurred on Sunday morning opposite Olabode House, between Anthony and Obanikoro. item.title: VIDEO: TikTok Star Peller Crashes Mercedes After Making Alarming Suicide Statements on Livestream
item.description: Popular TikTok content creator and livestreamer, Hamzat Habeeb, widely known as Peller, has sparked outrage and concern after crashing his car during a live broadcast on Lekki-Epe Expressway in Lagos. item.title: Tinubu, ECOWAS leaders meet in Abuja over Benin coup, regional stability
item.description: President Bola Tinubu and leaders of ECOWAS countries are currently meeting in Abuja. The 68th Ordinary Session of the ECOWAS Authority of Heads of State and Government is taking place at the State House Conference Centre, in Abuja. Leaders of West African countries at the meeting include President Julius Bio (Sierra Leone, ECOWAS Chair), President Patrice Talon (Benin), José Maria Neves (Cabo Verde) and Alassane Ouattara (Côte d’Ivoire). item.title: FG bans SS3 student admission, transfers to curb exam malpractice
item.description: The education ministry has banned student transfer into SS3 classes across all public and private secondary schools. item.title: Disquiet as Tinubu approves ‘special promotion’ for his ADC — barely a year after elevation to colonel
item.description: President Bola Tinubu has approved the “special presidential promotion” of his aide-de-camp (ADC), Nurudeen Yusuf, from the rank of colonel to brigadier-general. The approval was conveyed in a letter from the office of the national security adviser (NSA) to the chief of army staff.
